name: Mortal Kombat: Deception — Shao Kahn Biography
notes: Official in-game Shao Kahn biography reproduced by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Shao Kahn states that after his earlier defeat and while Kitana's forces closed in, he created a clone of himself to draw his enemies' attention and escaped into the wilds. This directly establishes the clone-decoy and escape history and demonstrates that the real Shao Kahn survived the period previously portrayed more simply as his death. The biography does not explicitly identify which enemies later struck or killed the clone.
